title: The Pegasus Reports of 2021
grammar: Recap: reporting what someone stated with azt mondta, hogy
goal: I can describe how the Pegasus reports of 2021 came out and what the Hungarian government said about them, with dates (*kémszoftver, titkosszolgálat, megfigyelés*).
I can report what each side stated with *azt mondta, hogy* and *azt közölte, hogy* (*az NSO Group azt közölte, hogy …*).
I can keep a company's, an investigator's and a government's claims apart from my own voice.

sections.title: Unit 35: Covert Surveillance and the Pegasus Case, 2021–2026
body: In July 2021 an international group of journalists reported that the spyware Pegasus had been used in several countries, among them Hungary. The Hungarian government said its secret services had acted within the law; critics, among them journalists and human rights organisations, questioned how covert surveillance was authorised and supervised. The case was also examined by a committee of the Hungarian parliament and by a committee of the European Parliament.

In five short accounts you follow these events year by year, name who judged them how, and practise the forms a neutral history needs: reporting, obligation in the past, degrees of certainty, concession and verbal nouns. The period ends with the parliamentary election of 12 April 2026.
